history.summary: test(A19b): the history-states walk keeps the whole /snap beside each capture (no field values, home rewritten) for the shell's numeric checks

fix(A19b): no 'New chat defaults' strip over a Session whose history is loading or could not be read (it is not a New chat); replay_serve's history scenario takes --history-delay-ms / --history-unknown; the a19 history-states walk proves, by /snap numbers at both sizes, 'Loading conversation…' from the first frame until the history arrives (never the welcome) and 'Session recovery required' + the server's reason after the refused retry

fix(A19b): never the empty welcome for an open's round trip — the window switches to a Session the moment its open goes out, so the Session is 'Loading conversation…' from then (not only once its history read is asked) until the history settles; a refused open or a workspace mismatch shows the reason; a server without session/hydrate is not waited on; a New chat (minted here) shows its welcome at once, never a loading flash; tests hold the open reply and the new chat's read

test(A19b): the live walk's upgrade phase samples from the first frame (never the empty welcome), checks the profile was resolved before the socket, and scroll-reads to the real top (six still steps: the instrument clips rects, so one tall paragraph read the same for two); the sidebar phase proves the retry live (unknown session on a socket without the profile, re-dial carrying it, re-open in its folder, the whole history); the reconnect re-open's trace frame names its cwd

fix(A19b): the connection carries the Session's profile — Core resolves a Session id that does not embed its profile (dsflash:main; octos-core SessionKey::profile_id reads only profile:channel:chat) from the socket's X-Profile-Id, so the one-time migration resolves the previous profile BEFORE the socket (Start::MigrateAs), and a history refused as 'unknown session' on a socket without the Session's profile re-dials carrying it (Link::carry_profile; the A12 re-dial re-opens it in its folder); the fake server answers by the socket's header; the live walk's upgrade phase

fix(A19b): never an empty transcript over a Session with history — the migration reopens the previous Session IN the folder its history is recorded in (found by the per-workspace catalog, session/list {cwd, profile_id}, web workspace-session-catalog.ts:193-208); a hydrate refused as 'unknown session' is retried once in the Session's found folder before the timeline shows; the conversation shows 'Loading conversation…' until the history arrives and 'Session recovery required' + the reason when it cannot be read; a listed Session resumes with its workspace (App.tsx:1778-1783); a folder-less open is not remembered as a cwd

Merge A18: light-theme text at the web's levels (no informational text below ~5.5:1; accent text tokens; disabled ink exempt), dark-theme rows and links fixed; CONTRAST_PAIRS + contrast_tests guard every text ink on every fill in both palettes; the stale-window 'Turn stopped' no longer restored and at most one outcome notice per turn
